v1_falsification: V1 reached 1.0 strict JSON validity but collapsed all train and held-out states to ensemble plus predict; its unweighted completion loss was dominated by invariant JSON tokens.
objective: Test whether explicitly weighting the decision-value tokens teaches the 360M teacher the frozen target-free router policy before gated OPD.
evidence_boundary: Synthetic SFT states and retrospective real transfer edges may validate formatting, policy imitation, and execution only. They cannot establish scientific routing benefit or authorize promotion.

training_information.prompt_fields: the 12 target-label-free RouterState fields from catalyst-opd-router-shadow-v1
training_information.weighted_values: expert, action, confidence, and reason-code value spans

synthetic_state_generation.stratification: exactly equal frozen quotas across ensemble-abstain and Standard, MHAR, ensemble crossed with predict or rank

real_state_evaluation.reason: the real outcomes were already inspected during method development and are not sealed external confirmation

promotion_rule: Remain shadow-only regardless of retrospective performance. Promotion requires a newly sealed external programme under catalyst-opd-router-shadow-v1.
